answer: Reaching the vine of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the echo. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
